diagnosis: Mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia with BCR::ABL1 fusion, B/T/myeloid phenotype
legend: The peripheral blood smear shows three separate populations of CD34+ blasts. The B lymphoblasts are positive for CD10 (bright), CD19, CD20 (partial), CD22, CD33 (partial), and TdT, and negative for CD13, CD25, CD66c, KIT (CD117), cytoplasmic IgM, and myeloperoxidase. The T lymphoblasts are positive for CD1a, CD2, cCD3, CD4 (partial), CD5, CD7, and TdT, and negative for CD3, CD8, CD13, CD33, KIT (CD117), and myeloperoxidase. The myeloblasts are positive for CD13, CD33 (partial), CD38 (dim), KIT (CD117), and CD123, and negative for CD2, CD7, myeloperoxidase, and TdT.
